clearedSpotChecks.note: I reran cycles/019/op-stack-eth.work/parity.py on 2026-11-25 against the seven networks.json endpoints with output in my scratchpad. Chains 10, 8453, 7777777, 480, 57073 and 1868 return 24,009 bytes equal to build/PoolManager.json with the immutable at offset 13,606 set to the chain's address. Unichain returns 24,050 bytes with a common prefix of 23,997. In the build, byte 23,996 is 0xfe and bytes 23,997 to 24,008 are the trailer a164736f6c634300081a000a (CBOR map with only the solc version, matching settings.metadata.bytecodeHash none); Unichain's tail is a2 64 'ipfs' 5822... 64 'solc' 0.8.26 0033, a metadata map only. The clearance holds. One limit: I could not rebuild build/PoolManager.json from src/ because no compiler is installed, so the link between the build file and this checkout rests on earlier cycles.

clearedSpotChecks.note: OptimismPortal2.sol on develop, lines 940 to 942: from = msg.sender, replaced by AddressAliasHelper.applyL1ToL2Alias(msg.sender) unless EOA.isSenderEOA(). EOA.sol treats only msg.sender == tx.origin or 23 bytes of code beginning 0xEF0100 as an EOA; a contract cannot hold code starting with 0xEF (EIP-3541), so the second branch matches only 7702 delegated accounts that still need the private key. The alias offset is 0x1111000000000000000000000000000000001111 (vendor/AddressAliasHelper.sol line 22). I recomputed the six un-aliased preimages and queried eth_getCode and eth_getTransactionCount on https://ethereum.publicnode.com (reth/v2.11.0-b9abbcc, block 0x1944373) and on https://eth.drpc.org (Geth/v10.0.0/drpc, block 0x1944376): all twelve addresses have code 0x and nonce 0 on both. The networks.json L1 URL https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com now returns a Cloudflare challenge, so I used the other two. Reaching either address needs a key for a fixed address or a 160 bit CREATE2 match. Only develop source of the portal was read; the portal versions installed for Zora, World Chain, Ink and Soneium were not read, though every portal version I know of aliases a contract caller. The PoolManager checks in this path are unlock and the lock (src/PoolManager.sol:104-114) and onlyWhenUnlocked on take (src/PoolManager.sol:96-99, 291-297).
